sensitivity_interpretation: Each dimension is downgraded separately while other evidence stays fixed. These are rubric diagnostics, not new valid application records or external hiring validation. Sensitivity shares the rubric functions; chronology, coverage and workload checks above are separately implemented.
limitations: Provisional priors, templates and rubric; no empirical RA hiring calibration.
Complete portfolios are unique, but task templates, institutions and observation wording repeat.
Evidence comes from projects and appointments completed before 2026; later work is intentionally absent.
Tier mean length balance does not eliminate individual length or writing-style effects.
Same-model factual review is not independent human validation.
